target_identification.catalogue_identity: Gaia DR3 1648328016354496384; SIMBAD V* R Dra cross-identification
target_identification.spherex_counterpart: Catalogue position is inside both images; an independent source centroid/flux cannot be established because its core is invalid.
target_identification.source_confusion: Other catalogue entries near the star do not establish deblended infrared counterparts.

propagation.missing_radial_velocity: Zero assumed for propagation only; no measured radial velocity is fabricated.
propagation.annual_parallax: Not applied to barycentric ICRS predictions; amplitude bounded by the recorded parallax, far below a native pixel. Spacecraft ephemeris not supplied.

catalogue_prediction.error_limit: Catalogue diagonal terms only; no covariance, stellar photocentre or image-WCS systematic uncertainty included.

source_extraction.uncertainty_scope: Diagonal native variance + estimated background only; excludes pixel covariance, calibration, PSF/aperture, spectral and blend systematics. Not a variability significance.

reference_summary.interpretation: Reference ratios are conditional aperture diagnostics, not a target variability calibration or a complete systematic-error model.

uncertainty.explanation: Missing target pixels/variance prohibit a target flux or significance. PSF wings cannot replace the invalid core without validated saturation recovery, response matching, aperture corrections, covariance, blending and calibration uncertainties.

query.query: SELECT TOP 20 source_id,ra,dec,ref_epoch,pmra,pmdec,parallax,radial_velocity,ra_error,dec_error,pmra_error,pmdec_error,ruwe,phot_g_mean_mag,astrometric_params_solved,phot_variable_flag FROM gaia_dr3_source WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',248.16761083294998,66.75497941722,0.003))=1 ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag

catalogue.identity_reference_access: SIMBAD production-page indexed text confirmed R Dra / Gaia DR3 identifier; direct TAP access failed and that failure is preserved.
